# Ezekiel 18 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 18:4 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | Behold, all the-souls — to-Me they [are]; as-the-soul-of the-father, so also the-soul-of the-son — to-Me they [are]. The-soul that-sins — she shall-die. |
| LOGOS | Behold, all souls are Mine; the soul of the father as well as the soul of the son is Mine: the soul who sins shall die. |
| PNEUMA | Every living soul belongs to Me — parent and child alike. And this is My rule: The person who sins is the one who dies. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.

## 18:7 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | and-a-man he-has-not-oppressed, his-pledge for-a-debt he-has-returned, robbery he-has-not-robbed, his-bread to-the-hungry he-has-given, and-the-naked he-has-covered [with] a-garment, |
| LOGOS | does not oppress anyone, but restores to the debtor his pledge, commits no robbery, gives his bread to the hungry and covers the naked with a garment, |
| PNEUMA | He doesn't exploit anyone. He returns what a borrower puts up as collateral. He doesn't rob. He gives food to the hungry and clothes to those who need them. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus.
